title: dactylis glauca
intro: Dactylis glauca, commonly known as orchard grass, is a perennial grass native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, thanks to its ant-inflammatory and anti-diarrheal properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis glauca include its ability to soothe gastrointestinal issues and exhibit antioxidant and anti-histaminic effects. The bioactive constituents of Dactylis glauca include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
